'''2000 Naboo Regionals Mike Kessling The Unforgiven- Naboo Regional''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Mike Kessling]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 2nd at [[2000 Naboo Regionals]]. The description (8 June 2000) says: "This is the deck I used at the Naboo regional. Based on ...beating of a lifetime and past throne room decks of mine. Gone 12-1 for me in the UK." The post is signed "Mike Kessling / Naboo Regional runner-up". The regional was played on 4 June 2000 at Hatfield, Hertfordshire.<ref name="dt-7338">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7338 The Unforgiven- Naboo Regional], DeckTech (Mike "Kessling" Kessling, 8 June 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7338/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7338/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018163502/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7338/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''The Unforgiven- Naboo Regional'''
* '''Author:''' Mike "Kessling" Kessling
* '''Published:''' June 8, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This is the deck I used at the Naboo regional. Based on ...beating of a lifetime and past throne room decks of mine. Gone 12-1 for me in the UK.

=== Strategy ===

This is a throne room deck. It is obvious how to play people If you dont know how, look at ...beating of a lifetime...

THE THRONE ROOM SHOULD BE IN THE DECK......

use hnmenthe against ROPS.

In a few reviews they have said that this deck would have problems against HDADTJ. I havent won by less than 20 with this deck and 6 times I played it were against HDADTJ.

Mike Kessling Naboo Regional runner-up
